docs/site/site.css

This stylesheet belongs to the standalone offline reference. The published Starlight site uses web/styles/reader.css.

Style the standalone source and guide pages

Section titled “Style the standalone source and guide pages”

Selectors control the offline sidebar, source-line colors, tables and responsive layout. The offline page needs relative asset paths because it can be opened through file://. Changes here do not configure Starlight navigation or the global text-size selector.
